rules.title: Waterproof rating specification
rules.body: Only describe jackets as waterproof if they have a tested hydrostatic head rating of 10,000 mm or higher. For lower ratings use water-resistant.

rules.title: No 100% waterproof promises
rules.body: Never promise 100% waterproof protection in prolonged extreme downpours or continuous submersion.

rules.title: Stormproof terminology
rules.body: The term stormproof may only be applied to technical 3-layer hardshells featuring fully taped seams and storm flaps.

rules.title: Breathability ratings
rules.body: State breathability using precise MVTR (Moisture Vapor Transmission Rate) numbers (e.g., 20,000 g/m²/24h) rather than vague terms like fully breathable.

rules.title: DWR coating longevity
rules.body: Explain that Durable Water Repellent (DWR) requires periodic reapplication; do not imply DWR treatments last forever.

rules.title: Water resistance vs waterproof
rules.body: Clearly distinguish water resistance (repelling light spray) from waterproof construction (impermeable barrier with taped seams).

rules.title: Windproof rating criteria
rules.body: Claims of 100% windproof must be verified with CFM (Cubic Feet per Minute) air permeability ratings under 1 CFM.

rules.title: Seam sealing transparency
rules.body: Differentiate between critically taped seams and fully taped seams in all garment descriptions.

rules.title: Dry bag submersion limits
rules.body: State clearly that Northwind roll-top dry bags are intended for splash and quick submersion, not deep diving or prolonged underwater storage.

rules.title: Climbing harness fall arrest ratings
rules.body: Any statement concerning fall arrest ratings, dynamic load limits, or UIAA certification for climbing harnesses must be verified and signed off by the safety review board.

rules.title: Footwear waterproof lining
rules.body: Only shoes equipped with our NorthShield membrane may be marketed as waterproof hiking boots.

rules.title: Tent storm resistance claims
rules.body: Specify the Beaufort scale wind rating when claiming expedition tents withstand mountain storms.

rules.title: UIAA and CE compliance references
rules.body: Always state the exact UIAA or CE standard number (e.g., EN 12277) when referencing climbing safety certifications.

rules.title: Responsible risk depiction
rules.body: Depict outdoor activities with proper safety precautions, helmets, and buddy systems rather than reckless stunt behavior.

rules.title: Avalanche rescue gear limitations
rules.body: Safety beacons and probes must never be advertised as guarantees of avalanche survival; companion rescue training disclaimers are legally mandatory.

rules.title: Carabiner gate action terms
rules.body: Use precise technical terms (screwgate, twistlock, wiregate) and never generic terms like clip or clasp.

rules.title: Rope elongation specifications
rules.body: Always report both static elongation and first-fall dynamic elongation for all dynamic climbing ropes.

rules.title: Ice axe usage boundaries
rules.body: Distinguish classic mountaineering walking axes from aggressive curved technical ice tools for vertical ice.

rules.title: Crampon boot compatibility warning
rules.body: Include a notice specifying whether crampons require heel and toe welts (automatic/semi-automatic) or fit flexible trekking boots (strap-on).

rules.title: Via ferrata lanyard energy absorbers
rules.body: State explicitly that via ferrata sets are rated for specific user weight ranges (40 kg to 120 kg including gear).

rules.title: Trail etiquette and leave no trace
rules.body: Reinforce Leave No Trace (LNT) principles in trail guides, gear maintenance articles, and social posts.

rules.title: Helmet impact retirement rule
rules.body: Must emphasize that any climbing or ski helmet subjected to a major rockfall or fall impact must be immediately retired, even if damage is not visible.

rules.title: Belay device operation
rules.body: Do not use hands-free or automatic belay; use assisted-braking belay device according to manufacturer specifications.

rules.title: Bouldering crash pad landing zones
rules.body: Crash pads must be described as impact attenuators, not injury-prevention guarantees; always advise using attentive spotters.

rules.title: Recycled content percentages
rules.body: State the verified percentage of recycled polyester or nylon (e.g., 85% recycled polyester shell) instead of generic eco-friendly.

rules.title: PFC-free DWR descriptions
rules.body: Use PFC-free DWR or PFAS-free DWR; avoid saying chemical-free or toxin-free.

rules.title: Bluesign approved fabrics
rules.body: Only apply bluesign approved to products where at least 90% of textile components meet the bluesign standard.

rules.title: Responsible Down Standard (RDS)
rules.body: All down insulation statements must cite 100% Responsible Down Standard (RDS) certification and traceability.

rules.title: Fair Trade Certified sewing
rules.body: Only garments sewn in Fair Trade Certified facilities may use the Fair Trade Certified sewn badge and claims.

rules.title: Avoid greenwashing buzzwords
rules.body: Never use vague terms such as completely green, nature-positive, or non-polluting without verifiable third-party certification.

rules.title: Microplastic shedding disclosures
rules.body: Provide washing bag recommendations (e.g., Guppyfriend) when discussing fleece maintenance to reduce synthetic fiber loss.

rules.title: Organic cotton certification
rules.body: Reference Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) certification for all organic cotton claims.

rules.title: Repair program priority
rules.body: Promote repair and patching over replacement in support of circular economy initiatives.

rules.title: Packaging recyclability claims
rules.body: Only claim packaging is recyclable if it is widely accepted in curbside municipal recycling streams.

rules.title: Ironclad lifetime warranty terms
rules.body: All formal representations of the Northwind Lifetime Warranty must cite practical product lifespan and exclude ordinary wear-and-tear and UV degradation.

rules.title: Warranty service terminology
rules.body: Use factory repair service rather than free repair forever to maintain accurate customer expectations.

rules.title: Wear and tear exclusions
rules.body: Make explicit that crampon punctures, zipper blowouts from overpacking, and campfire ember burns are serviced under paid repair, not manufacturer warranty.

rules.title: Turnaround time for repairs
rules.body: Quote repair turnaround as 2 to 3 weeks during peak season; do not promise same-week repairs.

rules.title: Replacement part availability
rules.body: Only advertise tent poles, buckles, and zipper sliders as available if currently in stock at the repair hub.

rules.title: Third-party modification impact
rules.body: Explain that unauthorized tailoring or re-seaming voids the factory waterproof seam warranty.

rules.title: Original owner limitation
rules.body: Specify when warranty coverage is limited to the original purchaser with proof of purchase.

rules.title: Worn Wear trade-in valuations
rules.body: Trade-in store credit values must match the published seasonal trade-in matrix exactly.

rules.title: Honest gear lifespan communication
rules.body: Acknowledge that ultralight race gear has a shorter operational lifespan than rugged expedition heavyweights.

rules.title: Zipper maintenance guidance
rules.body: Advise salt-water rinsing and silicone lubrication when highlighting saltwater resilience on coastal paddling jackets.

rules.title: Backcountry inherent risk disclaimer
rules.body: Any instructional backcountry ski or mountaineering article must carry the standard legal assumption-of-risk liability waiver.

rules.title: Navigation equipment advisory
rules.body: Advise users to carry a physical topographic map and magnetic compass alongside GPS watches and mobile mapping apps.

rules.title: Water filter pathogen limits
rules.body: State whether filters remove bacteria and protozoa only (0.1 micron microfilters) or also neutralize viruses (purifiers).

rules.title: Bear canister regulation compliance
rules.body: Confirm IGBC (Interagency Grizzly Bear Committee) certification before claiming a canister meets National Park regulations.

rules.title: First aid kit readiness disclaimer
rules.body: Note that first aid contents require appropriate wilderness medicine training and regular expiration checks.

rules.title: Emergency beacon satellite subscription
rules.body: Always disclose that satellite SOS communicators (e.g., inReach, SPOT) require an active paid satellite service plan.

rules.title: Copyright and photography rights
rules.body: Ensure all community adventure photography is shared with explicit creator consent and photo credit.

rules.title: Competitor comparative testing disclosure
rules.body: Direct comparisons with named competitor products require independent laboratory testing and legal approval before publication.

rules.title: No trademark disparagement
rules.body: Do not use competitor brand names or trademarks pejoratively in marketing copy or social media replies.

rules.title: Drone usage on public lands
rules.body: Never showcase aerial footage shot in designated Wilderness Areas or National Parks where drone operations are prohibited.

rules.title: Alpine fit layering clearance
rules.body: Explain that Alpine Fit garments are tailored slim to fit under a harness, while Expedition Fit allows multiple insulating layers.

rules.title: Unisex versus gender-specific fit
rules.body: Use gender-inclusive sizing or unisex sizing with dual measurements rather than simply labeling as men's.

rules.title: Boot sizing for downhill hiking
rules.body: Recommend leaving a finger-width of clearance in the toe box to prevent bruising during steep descents.

rules.title: Backpack torso length measurement
rules.body: Direct customers to measure their torso from the C7 vertebra to the iliac crest, not their overall height.

rules.title: Sleeping bag temperature ratings
rules.body: Distinguish ISO/EN Comfort ratings (for women/cold sleepers) from Limit ratings (for men/warm sleepers).

rules.title: Glove finger dexterity
rules.body: Clarify that heavy expedition mittens prioritize warmth over rope handling and dexterity.

rules.title: Inseam length options
rules.body: State regular, short, and long inseam measurements in both inches and centimeters.

rules.title: Helmet sizing head circumference
rules.body: Provide head circumference range in centimeters for small/medium and large/xlarge climbing helmets.

rules.title: Price match guarantee and deep discounts
rules.body: Promotions advertising discounts greater than 40% off or price match guarantees must be reviewed by the commercial lead.

rules.title: Discount duration transparency
rules.body: Every seasonal sale or promotional code must clearly state start date, end date, and time zone.

rules.title: MSRP comparison rules
rules.body: Comparative pricing (was/now) must represent genuine historical selling prices within the past 90 days.

rules.title: Coupon code stacking policy
rules.body: State whether promo codes may be combined with pro deals, member points, or existing clearance markdowns.

rules.title: Free shipping threshold clarity
rules.body: State the exact order value required for free ground shipping (e.g., free shipping on domestic orders over $75).

rules.title: Say outlet or clearance, never cheap
rules.body: Describe discounted past-season gear as clearance, archive sale, or previous-season stock; never use cheap or bargain-basement.

rules.title: Pro deal confidentiality
rules.body: Remind outdoor industry professionals that pro purchase pricing is strictly confidential and not for resale.

rules.title: Final sale liquidation conditions
rules.body: Clearance items marked as final sale must prominently disclose that no returns, exchanges, or store credits are permitted.

rules.title: Gift card validity
rules.body: Northwind gift cards never expire and do not incur non-use dormancy fees.

rules.title: Member dividend distribution dates
rules.body: Specify that annual co-op member dividends are calculated on full-price purchases and distributed each March.

rules.title: Sponsored partnership disclosure
rules.body: All creator partnerships must include prominent, unhidden disclosures such as #ad, #paidpartnership, or #NorthwindAmbassador at the beginning of caption text.

rules.title: Gifted product clarity
rules.body: Creators receiving complimentary expedition gear must explicitly disclose gifted product in all social videos and posts.

rules.title: Authentic adventure voice
rules.body: Ambassadors must share candid, field-tested reflections rather than scripted corporate talking points.

rules.title: Permit compliance for filming
rules.body: Ensure commercial filming permits (e.g., USFS, BLM, Parks Canada) are secured before shooting promotional footage on protected public lands.

rules.title: Safety gear in influencer media
rules.body: Ambassadors featured in climbing, skiing, or paddling media must visibly model appropriate helmets, PFDs, or beacons.

rules.title: Environmental stewardship emphasis
rules.body: Ambassador content should spotlight trail conservation, cleanups, and respect for Indigenous lands.

rules.title: Ambassador title consistency
rules.body: Refer to sponsored athletes as Northwind Athlete Ambassadors or Northwind Field Testers.

rules.title: Affiliate link disclosure
rules.body: Disclose that affiliate links generate a commission at no additional cost to the purchaser.

rules.title: Pre-production gear testing disclaimer
rules.body: Prototypes showcased in field testing media must carry the label Prototype — specifications may vary upon release.

rules.title: No toxic outdoor elitism
rules.body: Welcome beginners and trail enthusiasts of all backgrounds; avoid gatekeeping or condescending mountain-purist language.

rules.title: Sleeping pad R-value insulation
rules.body: State sleeping pad insulation according to ASTM F3340-18 R-value testing standards and provide ground condition context.

rules.title: Merino wool temperature regulation
rules.body: Explain that merino wool regulates temperature when wet through active evaporative resistance, but is not an impenetrable heat generator.

rules.title: Frostbite and hypothermia warning claims
rules.body: Do not claim winter garments prevent frostbite or hypothermia under any extreme meteorological condition without strict medical advisories.

rules.title: Sun protection UPF ratings
rules.body: UPF claims must cite standard testing (e.g., UPF 50+ blocks 98% of UVA/UVB rays) and note that wet, stretched fabrics lose protection.

rules.title: Insect shield repellent durability
rules.body: State that permethrin insect-repellent fabric treatments remain effective through a maximum of 70 washes.

rules.title: Footwear blister prevention guidance
rules.body: Frame blister prevention around proper boot break-in, moisture-wicking sock layering, and early friction hotspot taping.

rules.title: Hydration bladder cleaning and mold
rules.body: Provide cleaning and drying instructions for antimicrobial TPU hydration bladders to avoid bacterial contamination.

rules.title: Electrolyte balance advice
rules.body: Advise proper hydration balance with electrolytes during high-exertion trail runs, without prescribing medical treatments.

rules.title: Camp stove carbon monoxide hazard
rules.body: Prominently warn against using canister or liquid-fuel camp stoves inside enclosed tents due to fatal carbon monoxide poisoning risks.

rules.title: High altitude sickness mitigation
rules.body: Never claim clothing or basic equipment treats acute mountain sickness (AMS) or high-altitude pulmonary edema (HAPE); proper acclimatization is required.

rules.title: Grounded and rugged voice
rules.body: Use clear, dependable, and field-tested prose. Avoid trendy metropolitan lifestyle jargon that feels disconnected from the trail.

rules.title: No hyperbole or exaggerated claims
rules.body: Avoid hyperbolic claims like indestructible, miracle fabric, or legendary unless citing documented independent lab awards.

rules.title: Concise gear descriptions
rules.body: Lead with weight, packability, and performance benefits before atmospheric outdoor storytelling.

rules.title: Honest product limitations
rules.body: Be transparent about design trade-offs: an ultralight shell trades heavy brush durability for trail speed.

rules.title: Humility toward nature
rules.body: Depict nature as a force to respect, learn from, and adapt to, never as something to conquer or dominate.

rules.title: Encouraging tone for newcomers
rules.body: Demystify outdoor skills for day hikers and camp novices without talking down to experienced alpinists.

rules.title: Active voice in technical guides
rules.body: Use direct, active verbs in instructional copy (e.g., Pitch the tent into the wind, Anchor the guyout lines firmly).

rules.title: Punctuation restraint
rules.body: Limit exclamation points to at most one per post or headline; let the mountain scenery and gear performance inspire the reader.

rules.title: No clickbait headlines
rules.body: Write informative, descriptive titles for trail reports and gear breakdowns rather than sensational clickbait.

rules.title: Respect for local mountain communities
rules.body: Acknowledge local guide cultures, Sherpa heritage, and Indigenous stewards whenever recounting mountain expeditions.

rules.title: Dual metric and imperial units
rules.body: Always provide measurements in both metric and imperial units (e.g., 450 g / 15.8 oz, 2,500 m / 8,200 ft).

rules.title: Regional gear naming
rules.body: Acknowledge regional variations (e.g., trekking poles vs hiking poles, pack vs rucksack, gaiters vs leg protectors).

rules.title: Extreme hydrostatic head depth ratings
rules.body: Claims involving marine drysuits, packraft spraydecks, or immersion gear rated above 25,000 mm hydrostatic head must be approved by technical testing directors.

rules.title: Sub-zero temperature descriptions
rules.body: Specify whether temperatures are Fahrenheit or Celsius to prevent dangerous confusion in sub-zero alpine conditions.

rules.title: Trail difficulty grading systems
rules.body: Reference standard Yosemite Decimal System (YDS) or regional equivalent (e.g., Class 1 trail to Class 5 technical climbing).

rules.title: Elevation gain versus trail distance
rules.body: Clearly separate horizontal distance from cumulative vertical elevation gain in trail overviews.

rules.title: CamelCase hashtags for screen readers
rules.body: Write multi-word hashtags in CamelCase (e.g., #NorthwindOutdoor, #TrekTheRidge, #LeaveNoTrace) so screen readers pronounce words correctly.

rules.title: Hashtag quantity cap
rules.body: Use no more than 3 targeted hashtags per post to avoid clutter and preserve brand dignity.

rules.title: Restrained emoji usage
rules.body: Use at most two outdoor-themed emojis (e.g., 🌲, ⛰️) per caption; never replace vital instructional words or warnings with emojis.

rules.title: Descriptive image alt text
rules.body: All published product and expedition photography must include complete alt text detailing the terrain, gear model, and environmental context.

rules.title: Color contrast in gear graphics
rules.body: Ensure infographic text and gear diagrams maintain a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background imagery.

rules.title: Descriptive link text
rules.body: Never use generic phrases like click here or read more as hyperlink anchors; use specific phrases like Explore the Glacier Ridge 3P tent specs.

rules.title: Official brand color palette
rules.body: Use only Northwind primary colors: Evergreen (#1B4332), Slate Granite (#343A40), Snow White (#F8F9FA), and Alpine Sun Gold (#DDA15E).

rules.title: Logo clear space requirements
rules.body: Maintain a minimum clear space surrounding the Northwind mountain compass emblem equal to the height of the letter N.

rules.title: No photographic color filters
rules.body: Keep landscape and expedition photography natural; do not apply oversaturated vintage filters that distort actual fabric colors.

rules.title: Zero-landfill and net-zero carbon claims
rules.body: All public statements concerning corporate carbon neutrality or zero-waste facility certification must be validated by the environmental audit council.

rules.title: Video captions and subtitling
rules.body: All video reviews, how-to guides, and reels must include open or closed captions for hearing-impaired audiences.

rules.title: Approved technical specification citation
rules.body: Every published technical metric (weight, pack volume, fabric denier, tear strength) must match the approved engineering specification sheet exactly.

Northwind is a certified 1% for the Planet member, donating 1% of total annual sales to grassroots trail preservation.

Northwind hiking socks carry an unconditional lifetime guarantee against friction wear-through.
The Northwind BearLock food container is certified bear-resistant by the Interagency Grizzly Bear Committee (IGBC #5420).
Northwind WindBlocker softshells deliver a laboratory air permeability rating under 0.5 CFM.
All Northwind cardboard packaging boxes are made from 100% post-consumer recycled paperboard and printed with soy ink.

Northwind Pro Deal purchasing is restricted to verified wilderness guides, SAR personnel, and certified outdoor educators.
Northwind Trekking Poles feature double-cam FlickLock adjusters crafted from aircraft-grade 7075 aluminum.
Annual member dividends are credited on March 15th for the previous calendar year full-price purchases.
Northwind solar chargers feature 24% high-efficiency monocrystalline cells with dual USB-C PD outputs.
The Northwind AltiGrip mountaineering boot sole utilizes Vibram Mont compound formulated for sub-zero traction.
Northwind headlamps carry an IPX8 waterproof rating, submersible up to 1.5 meters for 30 minutes.
Over 60% of Northwind apparel is assembled in Fair Trade Certified sewing facilities.

Northwind sun hoodies are certified UPF 50+, blocking greater than 98% of harmful ultraviolet radiation.
Northwind packraft hulls are constructed from 210D single-coated urethane nylon with a 840D double-coated floor.
Northwind factory repair centers maintain original replacement zippers, sliders, and buckles dating back 10 production years.
The Northwind Expedition Duffel features 900D recycled polyester with a weather-resistant TPU film laminate.
Northwind headquarters and Bozeman distribution center operate on 100% locally contracted renewable wind energy.

terms.note: Use waterproof only when adhering to tested 10,000 mm+ hydrostatic ratings
Maintain brand prestige by referring to discounted items as clearance or past-season archive
Specify precise recycled content percentages instead of vague green claims
Use inclusive, respectful wording for outdoor hobbyists
Climbing safety devices still require active brake hand control
Official company terminology for factory restoration and repair centers
Accurate technical terminology for non-fluorinated Durable Water Repellent
